gitPolicy: No push. Plan workers make no branches, worktrees, stashes or commits. Workflow finalization makes one local commit. Never commit src-tauri/target, src-tauri/gen, node_modules or dist.

serialReconciliation.gate: After all plans join, reconcile serially re-runs the root gates and the subproject/Rust/native gates with logs under tmp/tauri-editor-20261110/reconcile.

reviewContext.userProblem: Add a standalone Tauri 2 desktop editor example built on emaki under examples/tauri-editor/. It launches as a native window and edits real files on disk with emaki syntax highlighting.
requiredOutcomes: npm run tauri dev launches a native window with an emaki WebGL2 editor filling the window.
New/Open/Save/Save As shortcuts; a CLI path opens on launch; the title shows the file name and a dirty marker; confirm before discarding on New/Open/close.
Lazy resolveLanguage + loadLanguage detection with plaintext fallback; a status bar with language, line/col and an override select listing all registry languages; defaultTokenColors.
Subproject npm run check and npm run build pass.
cargo check, clippy -D warnings and cargo test pass, with read/write round trip, missing-file and UTF-8 tests.
A Playwright mocked-IPC smoke covers open -> edit -> save and language detection; a tauri build --debug --no-bundle log shows the binary builds.
README section; root check/test/build stay green.
nonGoals: Multi-tab or multi-window editing, find/replace, settings.
CRLF preservation (saved as LF) and non-UTF-8 encoding detection (rejected).
Bundled installers or signing; only --no-bundle is verified.
AppManifest command allow-list, atomic writes, undo history across remounts.
Any change to emaki src/, root package.json/package-lock.json, vactr or chilla.
constraints: Do not modify vactr or chilla; chilla/src-tauri is a read-only reference.
Root package gains no Tauri dependency; @codemirror/state and @codemirror/commands remain the only peers.
Tauri packages live only in examples/tauri-editor/package.json.
Root npm run check, npm test and npm run build stay green; the subproject is excluded from root tsc/vite scopes.
File IO only through read_text_file/write_text_file Rust commands; tauri-plugin-dialog for dialogs; no fs plugin; strict CSP.
Use ~/.cargo/bin/cargo; commit Cargo.lock; never commit src-tauri/target or gen/.
Terse framework-free TypeScript in emaki style.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Dialogs run Rust-side and read/write accept only paths granted via the CLI argument or a dialog.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: No fs plugin and no dialog:* permissions; the webview cannot read arbitrary paths (design §5, §11.1).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: emaki is consumed through Vite aliases and TS paths to ../../src.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: One CodeMirror instance, no built dist needed, no root lockfile change (design §4, §11.2).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: The editor is remounted on Open/New/language override.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: emaki fixes the language at creation; no library change needed (design §11.3).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Save completion is conditional on a docId+rev snapshot (TAURI-DESIGN-001).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Edits made during a pending write stay dirty and are never discarded (design §7).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: CLI path via a custom initial_path command.
Smoke is a Node script using playwright with an in-process Vite server in mode 'mock'.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Matches root scripts/e2e.mjs, owns its lifecycle, adds no @playwright/test (design §11.5).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Evidence root is tmp/tauri-editor-20261110 with per-plan subdirectories.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Checkpoint aligned the accepted plans' tmp/tauri-editor paths to tmp/<taskId>; a mechanical path rename with no behavior change.

intentionalTradeoffs: Native GUI cannot be asserted headlessly; P05 records a best-effort launch and reports the GUI as not observed.
The tauri crate / @tauri-apps/api major.minor alignment is done via Cargo.lock only (C6) by P05.
P01 copies icon.png in addition to the 5 bundle.icon files and has 6 Rust tests (a superset of the design's 5).
README `npm run tauri dev -- -- path/to/file` forwarding is documented but not verified; CLI-path behavior is evidenced by launching the binary directly.
supportedEdgeCases: Edits during a pending write keep the document dirty and show 'Saved (newer edits unsaved)'.
Write error leaves path, language, dirty flag and text unchanged.
Unknown file extensions fall back to plaintext; loadLanguage failure mounts plaintext.
Missing file and invalid UTF-8 produce distinct error strings; ungranted paths are rejected.
Stale language loads are discarded by a mount token.
residualRisks: A GUI window cannot be asserted headlessly; P05 records best-effort launch evidence and states that the GUI was not observed.
The tauri crate / @tauri-apps/api major.minor may mismatch; P05 aligns them via Cargo.lock only or records a blocker.
A first Rust compile and network installs are slow; long foreground timeouts are needed.

acceptanceCriteria: The six C1 commands are implemented as async commands; read/write reject ungranted paths with 'path not permitted: '.
The CSP and devCsp match design §6; capabilities contain exactly the 4 listed permissions.
cargo fmt --check, check, clippy -D warnings and test exit 0; 6 tests pass.
icons/ holds the 6 generated original icons; Cargo.lock exists; the progress log records the resolved tauri version.
